summary: Compute connectivity gradients from both the structural connectome (SC) and the group-average functional connectivity matrix (FC) of the larval zebrafish brain using the diffusion map embedding algorithm (brainspace.gradient.embedding.diffusion_mapping, alpha=0.5), correlate the first two SC and FC gradients against each other, and project them onto the Mapzebrain atlas as bilateral centroid overlays in top (XY) and…
use_when: Analyze structural and functional connectivity gradients by diffusion map embedding
Generate structural and functional connectivity gradients by diffusion map embedding outputs
avoid_when: A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
